# Pipe Bombs
A pipe bomb is a crude, homemade explosive. It is cheap to make from common parts, has a short and unpredictable fuse, and throws out a burst of shrapnel. It is a favourite of insurgents and anyone else who can't get real grenades.
## What You Need - [bold]5 metal sheets[/bold] in a single stack. - [bold]A welder[/bold] with at least 5 units of fuel. - [bold]A lighter[/bold]. It is used up to make the fuse, so bring a second one to light the bomb. - [bold]5 lengths of cable[/bold] in a single coil.
## Making It Every step is a short do-after, so stand still until it finishes.
- [bold]1. Casing[/bold]: turn your welder on and use it on the stack of metal sheets. After 5 seconds it uses 5 sheets and 5 fuel and gives you an empty pipe bomb casing.
- [bold]2. Fuse[/bold]: use a lighter on the casing. After 2 seconds the lighter is used up and the casing is ready for wiring.
- [bold]3. Wiring[/bold]: use a cable coil on it. After 2 seconds it uses 5 cable and you have a finished pipe bomb.
## Using It - Light the fuse by using a lit lighter or another igniter on the pipe bomb, then throw it. - The fuse is [color=#FFA500]random[/color]: it goes off anywhere from 1 to 4 seconds after lighting. Don't hold on to it. - It explodes and throws out 20 pieces of shrapnel in every direction. Anyone standing near it will be hurt badly. ## Tips - Make the casings ahead of time. Metal and fuel are the slow part, and a casing is harmless until it's wired. - Throw it around corners or over cover. The short fuse leaves little time for the target to run.
